verdict.rationale: Oneleet's first-party docs describe an official Oneleet MCP server. Users add it to an AI assistant and connect through an OAuth browser login with workspace selection, so there are no keys to paste. Headless agents can instead use scoped service keys with full or limited scopes. The connected assistant acts as the user within their role, and every action is attributed to their account. A probe independently confirmed the MCP documentation page exists. missing for 10: a documented catalog of the MCP tools and actions the server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world use.
